create_DuplicateString: create a DuplicateString task with a given vocab_size and duplication count
run_DuplicateString_sample_batch: run DuplicateString sample_batch to generate jittable one-hot encoded string batches
test_DuplicateString_input_size: test DuplicateString input_size property returns the configured vocab_size
test_DuplicateString_output_size: test DuplicateString output_size property returns the configured vocab_size
test_DuplicateString_output_length: test DuplicateString output_length returns duplication times the input length
